review.assessment:
This change modifies `total_of` to quantize each line's total individually before summing, replacing the previous accumulation of unrounded values with a single final quantization. By ensuring every line is rounded to the chargeable amount first, the invoice total now exactly matches the printed per-line amounts across all eighteen orders without accumulating floating-point drift. The structural checks pass cleanly and acceptance tests confirm zero regressions.

Defects: None found.
